comp.texto: The FIPV sets a permanent international calendar, alternating each year between the Pikivoley World Cup and the Continental Cups, and sanctions world championships, international cups and continental competitions.
comp.foto_alt: Aerial night view of three Pikivoley courts, in red and green, surrounded by packed stands
copa.selo: First edition · Official launch of the FIPV
copa.texto: The 2027 edition, in Brazil, marks the start of the sport's official world calendar and brings together 16 countries at the first World Cup organized under the FIPV's international structure.
ciclo.a1.funcao: World Cup and official launch of the FIPV
ciclo.nota: The Continental Cups are part of the qualifying system for the following year's World Cup.
sistema.lead: Every country affiliated with the FIPV recognizes, at the end of each season, a single national champion per category.
sistema.texto1: National bodies may organize leagues, circuits, regional stages and other qualifiers throughout the year. But the national calendar must end in a final that decides a single official National Champion per category. There can never be two national champions of the same category in the same season.
sistema.texto2: The same applies to the Continental Cups: at the end of the competition, there is a single Continental Champion per category.
sistema.nota: A single international sports pyramid, linking each country's competitions to the FIPV's continental and world calendar.
comp.lema: One country. One champion. One continent. One champion. One world. One champion.
